title: Teacher dual-port-group requirement vs actual 1024-connection topology

teacher_nominal.note: the teacher nominal 48/16 for all 32 groups would need 1536 cross and 512 U endpoints, but the topology contains 1312 cross and 736 U endpoints, so the uniform 48/16 split cannot be produced by any 32-group partition of these 2048 endpoints

argument: 每个连接器 32 个孔全部使用；跨边端点计数为：16 个端部连接器（每边 01/02/15/16）各 16 个，48 个中部连接器（每边 03..14）各 22 个
任务书预检要求恰好 8 组为 32、24 组为 44；38 不允许出现，故任何组都不能把端部连接器与中部连接器配在一起
16 个端部连接器因此只能两两互配、恰好 8 对（即 8 个角部组）；48 个中部连接器只能两两互配、恰好 24 对（即 24 个其他组）
所以 8×(32 跨边/32 U) + 24×(44 跨边/20 U) 不是巧合，而是由每个连接器的跨边/U 拆分强制的；任何满足"端部-端部、中部-中部"的完美匹配都能精确复现该计数，因此仅凭计数无法确定绝对配对，需再按几何定位选择规则
pairing_constraint_derivation.conclusion: 预检分解可由任何"端部-端部、中部-中部"完美匹配复现；绝对配对必须用几何（角部定位与最小配对距离）确定，见候选规则

C_corner_cross_plus_side_mid.label: 角部跨边配对 (N01-W16 等 4 组) + 同边 (02-15) 4 组

E_corner_cross_two_per_corner.label: 每个角 2 组跨边配对 (N01-W16, N02-W15 等)

recommended_rule.label: 同边相邻连接器两两配对：每条边 (01,02),(03,04),...,(15,16)
recommended_rule.rationale: (i) 由计数推导必须端部-端部、中部-中部配对；(ii) 8 个角部组须每角 2 组，而每角的 4 个端部连接器只有 3 种配对，同边相邻 (01,02)+(15,16) 的配对总距离最小；(iii) 该规则是全局唯一最小总距离完美匹配（32×9 mm = 288 mm），且逐组精确复现预检的 8×(32/32) + 24×(44/20)

checks.name: every connector uses all 32 holes and splits into cross-edge / U endpoints
per-connector cross counts are exactly 16 (end) / 22 (middle): the only possible group sums are 32/38/44
the 8x32 + 24x44 target forces end-with-end and middle-with-middle pairing (38-type mixed pairs are excluded)
teacher nominal 48/16 for every group is infeasible with the actual 1312 cross / 736 U endpoint totals
at least one geometric pairing rule reproduces the precheck exactly
for every corner the minimum-distance pairing of its four end connectors is the same-side adjacent pairing (01-02)+(15-16)
rule A: exactly 8 corner groups (2 per board corner) and 24 other groups
rule A: corner groups are 32 cross / 32 U and other groups are 44 cross / 20 U (task-book precheck reproduced exactly)
rule A totals: 1312 cross endpoints / 736 U endpoints
rule A is the unique minimum-total-distance perfect matching: 32 x 9 mm = 288 mm = the global lower bound

detail.uniqueness_argument: every pair is at least 9 mm (adjacent same-side connectors); 288 mm is reached only when all 32 pairs are adjacent same-side pairs, and the perfect matching of a 16-point line into adjacent pairs is unique
